objective: Detect whether an architecture learns to retain experience across 10 or 18 distractor transitions and use it to predict a delayed query response; isolate the impact of state, recurrent gating, information availability, memory capacity and complete resource cost.

families.A_DELAYED_ECHO: One public initial cue observation o0; Query at timestep 10 or 18; intervening steps contain iid distractor observations and iid binary actions. At query action=2, next public observation is initial cue XOR Bernoulli(0.05); all other public next bits are iid fair.
families.B_DELAYED_ACTION_PARITY: Same public initial cue and iid distractors. The only query's next public observation is cue XOR parity of all preceding public action=1 events XOR Bernoulli(0.05). Query action=2. Previous action is never privileged.
families.NULL_DELAYED_QUERY_IID: Identical public query timing/action distributions, but next public query observation is iid fair independent of public history.

public_contract: At each t, model receives only current public bit o_t, public action a_t in {0,1,2}, and episode reset flag true only at t=0; predicts o_(t+1) before it is revealed. Evaluation metric is ONLY delayed query next-bit NLL; non-query bit never used as supervision. During offline fitting query target can be used for postprediction gradient; hidden cue/parity is never supplied as a label or feature.

models.GATED_2: Trainable two-cell sigmoid retention gate and tanh candidate, recurrent query-only BPTT, 12 epochs, Adam lr=0.01, exact 24-step truncation, clips 2.0, starts 17 and 31, selected on O8_PUBLIC_SELECT
models.GATED_4: Same gated recurrent architecture with four-cell capacity; independent frozen capacity variant 12 epochs, same Adam and starts, selected on O8_PUBLIC_SELECT
models.VANILLA_4: Four-cell vanilla tanh recurrence with query-only BPTT, 12 epochs, Adam lr=0.01, clips 2.0, starts 17 and 31; approximate capacity comparison with parameter counts explicitly reported
models.ERASED_GATED_2: No retraining: evaluate predeclared selected GATED_2 checkpoint with its state replaced by zeros immediately before final delayed query; identical query public features; report causal ablation but NOT a separately trained competitor
models.PUBLIC_QUERY_COUNTS: Fitted Laplace+1 table on (current_o,query_action,delay bucket), exact identical TRAIN episodes, no retained earlier cue.
models.PUBLIC_EPISODIC_TABLE: Fitted Laplace+1 table on (initial_public_cue, parity_of_observed_actions_before_query), explicitly engineered history features, full episode-history conventional comparator; no hidden labels, but not parameter-capacity matched.
models.PUBLIC_LOGISTIC_MEMORY: Fully trained logistic next-query-bit predictor with engineered public initial cue, action parity, cue*parity, query delay indicator and current observation, full-batch SGD 50 epochs fixed lr 0.3, L2 0.001; disclose feature advantage and parameter count.

evaluation.primary: Query-only Bernoulli mean next-bit NLL nats/bit per fresh family
evaluation.conventional_control: minimum of trained PUBLIC_QUERY_COUNTS, PUBLIC_EPISODIC_TABLE and PUBLIC_LOGISTIC_MEMORY
evaluation.ablation: ERASED_GATED_2 query NLL minus GATED_2 query NLL (positive means learned history state helps)
evaluation.capacity: compare GATED_2 to GATED_4 without selecting capacity on DEV
evaluation.recurrent: compare GATED_4 to VANILLA_4 with actual parameter counts, training CPU and serialized state disclosure
evaluation.memory: record full checkpoint size, learned state dimension and no-update DEV preservation
evaluation.cost: per-model training plus initialization selection CPU, DEV inference CPU, process CPU, tracemalloc peak and process peak RSS
evaluation.cross_os: all nine role/family SHA256 hashes exactly identical and all 3×8 reportable model/ablation NLLs agree within 1e-6 between native Linux and Windows
evaluation.null: do not treat noise overfit as discovery

limits: No protected original, HELD cohort, Q21/Q21N role, FSA admission, external science dispatch, Wingless/Yggdrasil integration or promotion.
No changes to original O1–O7 source, frozen budgets, negatives or evidence.
No architecture rediscovery claim from predesigned gate, public parity features or synthetic source.
No new controller, scheduler, queue, live D1/Cloudflare mutation, KTRADE/broker operation or paid API.
Separate draft, native Win/Linux, final Go regression and existing public FORGE checks required before review.
advancement: Only a reproducible retained-state effect with matched information and an acceptable accuracy-versus-cost tradeoff justifies prospectively testing truly unfamiliar independent source families; no scientific GO from this public development.
